描述_EN: guanyin is a goddess in chinese buddhism. the arms symbolize her ability to help different people with different needs. she manifests herself in many guises, one of which is known as the 'thousand arms guanyin'. in reality it would have been impossible to make a wooden figure with a thousand arms, so this figure has only twenty-four.
描述_ZN: 观音是中国佛教中的一位女神。 手臂象征着她有能力帮助不同需求的人。 她以多种身份示人，其中一个被称为 "千手观音"。 在现实中，不可能制作一个有一千条手臂的木制雕像，所以这个雕像只有二十四条。
